newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC seen cutting barley carryover stock.
newsitem.headline: ONIC seen cutting barley carryover stock.

text.p: France's grain office is expected to cut its estimate for its barley carryover stocks at end June 1997 to 807,000 tonnes from the 873,000 forecast last month, industry sources said on Friday.
Last year's June carryover was 626,000 tonnes.
The figures were drafted for a monthly report due to be released on Wednesday and may still be adjusted before official release.
Total use for the 1996/97 season was put slightly higher at 6.893 million tonnes, with exports to European Union partners raised to 2.48 million tonnes from the 2.37 million forecast last month.
